methods.label: Check both equations
methods.explanation: Substitution into the first equation gives \(1+2=3\); substitution into the second equation gives \(1-2=-1\). Both equations hold, so it is a solution of the system.
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 7 definition of a system's solution as a pair satisfying both equations.
